# P2 database benefits (generated by `python3 src/analysis.py benefits`)

The same question (H2: median source bytes per attack family) answered from the four raw
CSV parts as delivered and from the database. Times and memory are from one run on the
author's machine and vary between runs.

| Aspect | Raw files | Result | Database | Result | Consequence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Correctness | raw labels | 13 attack groups | repaired labels | 9 families | Fuzzers counted as 2 groups (19,195 + 5,051) |
| Integrity | no checks | 312 port values not decimal | load + verify.sql | 0 foreign-key violations | hexadecimal ports decoded, '-' stored as NULL |
| Time | read 4 parts (49 columns), answer H2 | 15.0 s | SQL join (8 columns), answer H2 | 5.8 s | 2.6x faster |
| Memory | DataFrame of the raw parts | 1,980 MB | DataFrame from the join | 483 MB | 4.1x smaller |
